def: The act of paying to use something, such as a car or flat, for a period of time.
付費在一段時間內使用某物，例如汽車或公寓。
ex: The rental car must be returned to the airport by noon on Friday.
這輛租來的車必須在週五中午前還到機場。
Monthly rental for the office space includes electricity and water.
辦公室空間的每月租金包含水電費。
We offer a bicycle rental service for hotel guests.
我們為飯店住客提供自行車出租服務。
Rental of the conference hall costs two hundred dollars an hour.
會議廳的租用費用為每小時兩百美元。
Please bring a valid driver's license when you collect the rental.
取車時請攜帶有效的駕照。

note: Usually a longer, formal contract; a rental can be as short as a day.
通常是較長期的正式合約；rental 可以短到一天。
British English for renting something for a short time, such as a car or hall.
英式英語，指短期租用，例如租車或租場地。
Rent is the regular payment for housing or space; rental more often means the service or the item rented.
rent 是為住所或空間定期支付的租金；rental 較常指租賃服務或租用的物品。

def: To open again after being closed, or to start again after a break.
停業或中斷後再次開放或重新開始。
ex: The museum will reopen on Monday after three months of renovation.
博物館經過三個月整修後，將於週一重新開放。
The store reopened under new management last spring.
這家店去年春天在新的經營團隊下重新開幕。
Management has decided to reopen the investigation into the missing funds.
管理階層決定重啟對遺失資金的調查。
Talks between the union and the company reopened this morning.
工會與公司之間的談判今早重新展開。
The airline plans to reopen its Osaka route in March.
這家航空公司計畫在三月重新開通大阪航線。

note: To continue after a pause; reopen is used for places, cases and talks that were closed.
指暫停後繼續；reopen 用於曾關閉的場所、案件與談判。

def: A person or thing that takes the place of another, or the act of replacing.
取代另一個人或物的人或東西，或更換這個動作。
ex: We will send a replacement as soon as we receive the damaged item.
我們一收到受損的商品就會寄出替換品。
The company is looking for a replacement for the retiring sales director.
公司正在為即將退休的業務總監尋找接替人選。
Regular replacement of the filters keeps the air clean.
定期更換濾網能讓空氣保持乾淨。
Do you cover the cost of replacement parts under the warranty?
保固是否涵蓋更換零件的費用？
Ms. Kato will serve as a temporary replacement while Mr. Reyes is on leave.
Reyes 先生休假期間，Kato 女士將擔任臨時代理人。

note: Often fills in for a short time or is a lesser alternative; a replacement takes over for good.
常指短暫代替或次一等的替代品；replacement 是長久接手。
A person who follows another in a job or title; a replacement can also be an object.
指接任某職位或頭銜的人；replacement 也可以指物品。
A refund gives your money back; a replacement gives you a new item instead.
refund 是退錢；replacement 是給你新的商品。

def: To change the time or date of a planned event.
更改已安排活動的時間或日期。
ex: Could we reschedule tomorrow's meeting to Thursday afternoon?
我們可以把明天的會議改到週四下午嗎？
The flight was rescheduled because of heavy snow.
班機因大雪而改期。
Dr. Chen asked to reschedule her appointment for next week.
陳醫師要求把她的預約改到下週。
We had to reschedule the training session after several staff members fell ill.
好幾位員工生病，我們不得不重新安排培訓課程的時間。
Please let us know if you need to reschedule your interview.
如果你需要改期面試，請告訴我們。

note: To move an event to a later time, often without a new date; reschedule gives a new time, earlier or later.
把活動延到之後，常未定新日期；reschedule 會給新時間，可早可晚。
Informal phrasal verb with the same meaning as postpone.
非正式的片語動詞，意思同 postpone。

def: To begin again or continue after a pause.
暫停後重新開始或繼續。
ex: Normal service will resume on the Blue Line at noon.
藍線將於中午恢復正常營運。
After the break, the meeting resumed with a report from the finance team.
休息之後，會議以財務團隊的報告繼續進行。
Production is expected to resume once the new machine is installed.
新機器安裝好後，預計將恢復生產。
The factory resumed operations two days after the storm.
暴風雨過後兩天，工廠恢復運作。
After two years abroad, he resumed his post as regional manager.
在國外兩年之後，他重新擔任區域經理一職。

note: To start something over from the beginning; resume continues from where it stopped.
指從頭開始；resume 是從中斷處繼續。
To keep going, with or without a stop; resume always follows a pause.
指持續進行，不一定有中斷；resume 一定是中斷之後。
A résumé (often spelled resume in US English) is a summary of your work history; it is a noun and sounds different.
résumé（美式常拼成 resume）是工作經歷摘要，為名詞，發音也不同。

def: A business or person that sells goods directly to the public.
直接向大眾銷售商品的企業或個人。
ex: The retailer offers free delivery on orders over fifty dollars.
這家零售商對滿五十元的訂單提供免費配送。
Many online retailers cut prices before the holiday season.
許多網路零售商在假期旺季前降價。
A small retailer may struggle to match the prices of large chains.
小型零售商可能很難與大型連鎖店的價格競爭。
The manufacturer sells its products through authorized retailers across Asia.
這家製造商透過亞洲各地的授權零售商銷售產品。
The electronics retailer is hiring seasonal staff for the winter.
這家電子產品零售商正在為冬季招募季節性員工。

note: A general word for anyone who sells; a retailer specifically sells to the public.
泛指任何賣東西的人；retailer 專指賣給一般大眾。
A person who owns or runs a small shop; a retailer can be a large company.
指經營小商店的人；retailer 也可以是大公司。

zh: 評論者；審查人員；審稿人
def: A person who examines or judges something, such as a book, product or document.
檢視或評價某物（如書、產品或文件）的人。
ex: The film reviewer praised the acting but criticized the script.
這位影評稱讚演技，但批評劇本。
Each report is checked by a second reviewer before it is published.
每份報告在發表前都由第二位審查人員檢查。
Several reviewers on the site complained about the slow delivery.
網站上有幾位評論者抱怨送貨太慢。
Please send your draft to the legal reviewer by Wednesday.
請在週三前把草稿寄給法務審查人員。
As a peer reviewer, she gives authors detailed feedback.
身為同儕審查者，她會給作者詳細的意見回饋。

note: A critic gives public opinions on books, films or art, usually as a profession; reviewer is broader.
critic 通常是專業地對書、電影或藝術公開發表意見；reviewer 範圍較廣。
A viewer watches something; a reviewer judges it and writes or reports an opinion.
viewer 是觀看的人；reviewer 則是評價並寫出或提出意見的人。

def: To write something again in order to improve it or correct mistakes.
為了改進或更正錯誤而重新寫一遍。
ex: Could you rewrite the opening paragraph so that it is shorter?
你可以把開頭那一段改寫得短一點嗎？
The manager asked us to rewrite the proposal before sending it to the client.
經理要求我們在把提案寄給客戶前先改寫。
The software team had to rewrite the whole program from scratch.
軟體團隊不得不把整個程式從頭重寫。
This letter needs a complete rewrite before it goes out.
這封信寄出前需要全部重寫。
The agreement was rewritten to include the new delivery terms.
合約經過改寫，納入了新的交貨條件。

note: To improve a text by changing parts of it; rewrite usually means writing much of it again.
指修改文字中的部分內容；rewrite 通常是大幅重寫。
To correct or adjust existing text; rewrite replaces large parts of it.
指更正或調整現有文字；rewrite 則是替換大部分內容。

def: Two slices of bread with a filling between them; also, to place something tightly between two things.
兩片麵包中間夾著餡料；也指把東西緊夾在兩者之間。
ex: I usually eat a chicken sandwich at my desk during lunch.
我午餐通常在辦公桌前吃一個雞肉三明治。
The café sells fresh sandwiches and coffee to commuters every morning.
這家咖啡館每天早上向通勤族販售新鮮三明治與咖啡。
The caterer will provide a selection of sandwiches for the afternoon seminar.
外燴業者將為下午的研討會提供多種三明治。
Our office is sandwiched between a bank and a bakery.
我們的辦公室夾在一家銀行和一家麵包店之間。
Would you like a sandwich or a salad with the soup?
湯要搭配三明治還是沙拉？

zh: 季節性的；隨季節變動的
def: Happening, available or suited to a particular time of the year.
在一年中的特定時節發生、供應或適用的。
ex: The shop hires seasonal workers every December to handle the extra customers.
這家店每年十二月都會僱用季節性員工來應付增加的顧客。
Seasonal demand for air conditioners peaks in July.
冷氣機的季節性需求在七月達到高峰。
The restaurant changes its menu to use seasonal vegetables.
這家餐廳更換菜單，改用當季蔬菜。
Hotel prices in the ski resort follow a seasonal pattern.
滑雪度假區的飯店價格遵循季節性的變動模式。
The report shows the figures after seasonal adjustment.
這份報告呈現的是經過季節調整後的數字。

note: Seasoned means experienced (a seasoned traveller) or flavoured with spices; it is not about the seasons.
seasoned 指經驗豐富（老練的旅行者）或調過味的，與季節無關。

def: Suddenly and by a large amount; or in a severe or direct way.
突然且幅度很大地；或指嚴厲、直接地。
ex: Sales rose sharply in the final quarter.
第四季銷售額急遽上升。
The price of fuel fell sharply after the announcement.
公告發布後，燃料價格大幅下跌。
The road turns sharply to the left just after the bridge.
過橋之後，道路急轉向左。
The director sharply criticized the delay in the report.
主任嚴厲批評報告的延誤。
Opinions on the merger are sharply divided among staff.
員工對合併一事意見嚴重分歧。

note: Stresses a striking change that is easy to see; sharply stresses speed and size.
強調引人注目、明顯的變化；sharply 強調變化的快與幅度。
Suddenly and without warning; it does not say how large the change is.
突然且毫無預警；不說明變化幅度有多大。
Common with prices, rates and slopes; slightly narrower than sharply.
常與價格、利率和斜坡連用；範圍比 sharply 稍窄。

def: A quantity of goods sent together, or the act of sending goods.
一起寄送的一批貨物，或寄送貨物的行為。
ex: The next shipment of fabric should reach our warehouse on Tuesday.
下一批布料應會在週二抵達我們的倉庫。
A shipment of laptops was delayed at customs.
一批筆記型電腦在海關被耽擱了。
Please check each shipment against the packing list when it arrives.
每批貨到達時，請對照裝箱單檢查。
Partial shipment is acceptable if the full order cannot be filled at once.
如果無法一次備齊整張訂單，可接受分批出貨。
The buyer inspected the shipment and reported three damaged crates.
買方檢查了這批貨，並回報有三個木箱受損。

note: Delivery is bringing goods to the customer; a shipment is the batch of goods being sent.
delivery 是把貨送到客戶手上；shipment 是被運送的那批貨。
A formal word for a batch of goods sent to someone; shipment is more common.
指寄送給某人的一批貨，較正式；shipment 較常用。
Shipping is the process or the cost of sending goods; a shipment is the goods themselves.
shipping 是運送的過程或費用；shipment 是貨物本身。

def: A person who is buying things in a shop or online.
在商店或網路上購買東西的人。
ex: Thousands of shoppers filled the mall on the first day of the sale.
特賣第一天，數千名購物者擠滿了購物中心。
Online shoppers can return most items within thirty days.
網路購物者可在三十天內退回大部分商品。
The survey asked shoppers why they preferred the new store layout.
這項調查詢問顧客為何偏好新的店內配置。
A frequent shopper card gives you points on every purchase.
常客卡讓你每次購物都能累積點數。
As a careful shopper, Mr. Park always compares prices before buying.
身為謹慎的消費者，Park 先生買東西前總會比價。

note: Anyone who buys from a business, even without visiting a shop; a shopper is browsing or buying right now.
指任何向企業購買的人，不一定到店；shopper 指正在逛或買的人。
A broader term in economics and marketing for anyone who uses goods or services.
經濟學與行銷中較廣的用語，指使用商品或服務的任何人。
A shopkeeper owns or runs a shop; a shopper is the person buying in it.
shopkeeper 是經營商店的人；shopper 是在店裡買東西的人。

def: In a short time from now, or soon after a stated event.
從現在起不久之後，或在某事發生後不久。
ex: The conference will begin shortly; please take your seats.
會議即將開始，請就座。
Mr. Alvarez will join you shortly.
Alvarez 先生稍後就會加入你們。
Shortly after the merger, several managers left the company.
合併後不久，有幾位經理離開了公司。
The package arrived shortly before noon.
包裹在中午前不久送達。
The CEO resigned in March; shortly thereafter, the board named a successor.
執行長在三月辭職，不久之後董事會就指定了接任者。

note: More common and less formal; shortly is typical in announcements and written notices.
更常用也較不正式；shortly 常見於廣播與書面通知。
A less formal phrase meaning after a short time.
較不正式的片語，意思是不久之後。
Briefly means for a short time or in few words; shortly means soon.
briefly 指短暫地或簡短地；shortly 指不久。

def: A large room where products such as cars or furniture are displayed for sale.
展示汽車或家具等商品以供銷售的大型空間。
ex: Visit our showroom to see the full range of kitchen appliances.
歡迎蒞臨我們的展示間，欣賞全系列的廚房電器。
The car showroom is open until eight o'clock on weekdays.
汽車展示間平日營業到八點。
The new sofa will be on display in the showroom from Monday.
新款沙發從週一起在展示間展出。
A sales assistant at the furniture showroom helped us choose a table.
家具展示間的銷售人員協助我們挑選桌子。
The designer is moving her showroom to a larger building downtown.
這位設計師要把她的展示間搬到市中心較大的建築。

note: An exhibition is a temporary public display; a showroom is a permanent place to display and sell.
exhibition 是暫時的公開展出；showroom 是長期展示並銷售的場所。

def: A long, comfortable seat with a back and arms for two or more people.
有靠背與扶手、可供兩人以上坐的長型舒適座椅。
ex: Please wait on the sofa in the lobby; Ms. Gomez will be with you soon.
請在大廳的沙發稍候，Gomez 女士馬上就來。
The company ships each sofa in protective plastic wrap.
公司將每張沙發用保護性塑膠膜包好後出貨。
We sell leather sofas in three colors.
我們販售三種顏色的皮沙發。
The sofa was damaged during delivery, so we requested a replacement.
沙發在運送過程中受損，所以我們要求換貨。
A corner sofa would fit better in the living room.
L 型沙發比較適合放在客廳。

note: More casual and very common in American English; sofa is slightly more formal.
較口語，在美式英語中非常常見；sofa 稍微正式一些。
Mostly British and somewhat old-fashioned.
主要是英式用法，略顯老派。
An armchair seats one person; a sofa seats two or more.
armchair 只坐一人；sofa 可坐兩人以上。

def: In the phrase in spite of, it means despite; alone, it means a wish to hurt someone.
在 in spite of 中意為儘管；單獨使用時指想傷害他人的惡意。
ex: In spite of the heavy rain, the outdoor event went ahead.
儘管下大雨，戶外活動仍照常舉行。
The flight was delayed twice; in spite of that, we reached the client on time.
班機延誤了兩次，儘管如此，我們還是準時抵達客戶那裡。
She finished the report on time in spite of being ill.
儘管生病，她還是準時完成了報告。
In spite of the fact that costs have risen, demand remains strong.
儘管成本上升，需求依然強勁。
He refused to share the files out of spite.
他出於惡意，拒絕分享檔案。
coll: in spite of the fact that

note: Same meaning but used without of: despite the rain. Slightly more formal.
意思相同，但後面不加 of：despite the rain，稍微正式。
Very formal, common in legal and contract writing.
非常正式，常見於法律與合約文件。
Although introduces a clause with its own subject and verb; in spite of is followed by a noun or -ing form.
although 後面接有主詞和動詞的子句；in spite of 後面接名詞或動名詞。

def: A computer file that arranges numbers in rows and columns for calculations.
把數字排成列與欄以便計算的電腦檔案。
ex: Please update the budget spreadsheet before Friday's meeting.
請在週五的會議前更新預算試算表。
I exported the sales data to a spreadsheet for analysis.
我把銷售資料匯出到試算表中進行分析。
The spreadsheet shows expenses for each department by month.
這份試算表按月顯示各部門的支出。
Everyone on the team can edit the shared spreadsheet online.
團隊中每個人都能在線上編輯這份共用試算表。
She built a spreadsheet to track inventory levels across three warehouses.
她建立了一份試算表來追蹤三座倉庫的庫存量。

note: A single page inside a spreadsheet file; it can also mean a printed practice sheet.
試算表檔案中的一個工作表；也可指印好的練習紙。

def: A neat pile of things placed one on top of another.
一件疊一件整齊堆起來的東西。
ex: A stack of invoices was waiting on her desk.
一疊發票正放在她的桌上等著處理。
Please stack the chairs against the wall after the seminar.
研討會結束後，請把椅子疊放在牆邊。
The boxes were stacked up to the ceiling in the storage room.
儲藏室裡的箱子堆到了天花板。
The clerk sorted the forms into neat stacks by department.
店員把表格依部門分成整齊的幾疊。
Items on the top shelf should not be stacked higher than one meter.
最上層架子的物品不應堆得超過一公尺高。

note: A pile can be untidy; a stack is usually neat and orderly.
pile 可以雜亂；stack 通常整齊有序。
An untidy and often larger mound; stack is neat.
雜亂且常常較大的一堆；stack 是整齊的。
Stock is goods kept for sale, or shares in a company; stack is a pile.
stock 是備售的存貨或公司股份；stack 是一疊東西。

def: At a regular, continuous pace, without sudden changes.
以規律、持續的步調進行，沒有突然的變化。
ex: Revenue has grown steadily over the past five years.
過去五年來，營收穩定成長。
Our website traffic is steadily rising, thanks to the new advertising campaign.
多虧新的廣告活動，我們的網站流量正穩定攀升。
Rain fell steadily all afternoon, so the outdoor fair was cancelled.
整個下午雨一直下個不停，所以戶外市集取消了。
She worked steadily through the pile of applications.
她埋頭穩穩地處理完那一疊申請書。
Our client base has steadily expanded since we opened a second branch.
自從開了第二間分店，我們的客戶群便持續擴大。

note: Stresses slow change in stages; steadily stresses a regular, unbroken pace.
強調分階段的緩慢變化；steadily 強調規律、不間斷的步調。
Stresses the same result or level every time; steadily stresses continued movement in one direction.
強調每次都有相同的結果或水準；steadily 強調朝同一方向持續移動。

def: A small paper or plastic label with glue on the back, used to mark or decorate things.
背面有膠、用來標示或裝飾的小型紙或塑膠標籤。
ex: Put a sticker on each box to show where it should go.
在每個箱子上貼一張貼紙，標明要送去哪裡。
A price sticker was still on the bottom of the vase.
花瓶底部還貼著價格標籤。
The security guard gave every visitor a sticker with a name and a date.
警衛給每位訪客一張寫有姓名與日期的貼紙。
Customers who complete the survey receive a free sticker.
完成問卷的顧客可獲贈一張貼紙。
Each laptop has a sticker with its serial number on the back.
每台筆電的背面都貼有印著序號的貼紙。

note: A label can be tied, sewn or printed as well as stuck on; a sticker always has glue.
label 可以是綁的、縫的或印的，也可以是貼的；sticker 一定有背膠。

def: In a way that must be obeyed exactly; or only and completely.
必須確實遵守地；或指僅僅、完全地。
ex: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the building.
大樓內嚴禁吸菸。
The company strictly follows safety rules in all its factories.
公司在所有工廠都嚴格遵守安全規定。
This offer is strictly limited to new customers.
這項優惠僅限新客戶。
Strictly speaking, the contract does not require us to pay for shipping.
嚴格來說，合約並未要求我們支付運費。
The meeting is strictly confidential, so please do not share the notes.
這場會議是絕對機密，請不要分享會議記錄。

note: Formal; stresses very careful, thorough application of rules or methods.
較正式；強調非常仔細、徹底地運用規則或方法。

def: An arrangement to pay regularly in order to receive a service or publication.
為取得某項服務或刊物而定期付費的安排。
ex: Your subscription to the magazine expires at the end of June.
你的雜誌訂閱將在六月底到期。
We offer a monthly subscription that you can cancel at any time.
我們提供可隨時取消的月訂閱方案。
The firm pays for an annual subscription to a financial news service.
這間公司支付一項財經新聞服務的年度訂閱費。
To renew your subscription, log in to your account and select a plan.
若要續訂，請登入帳號並選擇方案。
A one-year subscription includes access to all archived articles.
一年期訂閱包含所有歸檔文章的閱覽權限。

note: A prescription is a doctor's written order for medicine; a subscription is a regular paid service.
prescription 是醫師開的藥單；subscription 是定期付費的服務。

def: Better or higher in quality, rank or position than another.
品質、等級或地位比另一個更好或更高。
ex: This model is superior to the older one in both speed and battery life.
這款機型在速度和電池續航力上都優於舊款。
Please report the incident to your superior immediately.
請立刻向你的上司回報這起事件。
The hotel is known for its superior service and spacious rooms.
這家飯店以優質的服務和寬敞的房間聞名。
Her superior negotiation skills helped us win the contract.
她出色的談判技巧幫助我們贏得這份合約。
Ms. Ortiz is my superior, so she signs off on my expense claims.
Ortiz 女士是我的上司，所以由她核准我的費用申請。

note: A plain everyday word; superior is more formal and is followed by to, not than.
日常用語；superior 較正式，後面接 to 而不是 than。
Senior suggests higher rank or longer service within a group; superior compares one person or thing with another.
senior 指在團體中職位較高或年資較長；superior 是把一個人或物與另一個比較。

def: A person who watches over workers or an activity and makes sure it is done properly.
監看員工或某項活動，確保工作妥善完成的人。
ex: Please ask your supervisor to sign the leave request form.
請你的主管在請假單上簽名。
The shift supervisor checks the machines before the factory opens.
班別主管在工廠開工前檢查機器。
Ms. Ito was promoted from team member to supervisor last year.
Ito 女士去年從組員升為主管。
Each trainee works under the guidance of an experienced supervisor.
每位實習生都在資深主管的指導下工作。
A warehouse supervisor will meet the drivers at the loading dock.
倉庫主管會在裝卸區與司機碰面。

note: A manager usually runs a department or budget; a supervisor oversees the daily work of a smaller team.
manager 通常管理部門或預算；supervisor 監督較小團隊的日常工作。
Informal; used in speech for the person in charge of you.
非正式；口語中指你的頂頭上司。
A superior is anyone above you in rank; a supervisor directly watches and directs your work.
superior 是職位高於你的任何人；supervisor 是直接監看並指導你工作的人。

def: A thin, flat portable computer with a touch screen; also a small pill of medicine.
有觸控螢幕的薄型平面攜帶式電腦；也指小顆藥丸。
ex: Staff use a tablet to check in guests at the hotel entrance.
員工在飯店入口用平板為客人辦理入住。
I read the meeting notes on my tablet during the flight.
我在飛行途中用平板讀會議記錄。
Take one tablet with water after each meal.
每餐飯後以開水服用一顆藥片。
The software works on both tablets and smartphones.
這個軟體在平板和智慧型手機上都能使用。
The pharmacist handed her a box of headache tablets.
藥師遞給她一盒頭痛藥片。

note: Only for the medicine sense: pill is the everyday word; tablet is slightly more technical.
僅限藥片的意思：pill 是日常用語；tablet 稍微偏專業。
A table is a piece of furniture or a chart of data; a tablet is a flat device or a pill.
table 是桌子或資料表；tablet 是平板裝置或藥片。

def: A person whose job is to inspect, repair or operate technical equipment.
負責檢查、修理或操作技術設備的人。
ex: A technician will visit your office tomorrow to repair the printer.
技師明天會到你的辦公室修理印表機。
The lab technician prepared the samples for testing.
實驗室技術員準備好了要測試的樣本。
Our IT technicians are working to restore the network.
我們的資訊技術人員正在努力恢復網路。
The company is hiring a qualified technician to maintain its production line.
公司正在僱用一名合格的技師來維護生產線。
Before the broadcast, the sound technician checked every microphone.
播出前，音響技術員檢查了每一支麥克風。

note: A mechanic repairs vehicles and machines; a technician also covers electronic and laboratory equipment.
mechanic 修理車輛與機器；technician 也涵蓋電子與實驗設備。
An engineer designs and plans systems; a technician installs, maintains and repairs them.
engineer 設計並規劃系統；technician 負責安裝、維護與修理。

def: For a short period of time only, not permanently.
僅在短時間內，並非永久。
ex: The branch is temporarily closed for renovation.
這間分店因整修而暫時關閉。
Ms. Duval is temporarily covering for the sales manager.
Duval 女士暫時代理業務經理的工作。
Services will be temporarily unavailable during the system update.
系統更新期間，服務將暫時無法使用。
We have temporarily moved the training room to the second floor.
我們暫時把訓練教室搬到二樓。
Guests may temporarily leave their luggage at the front desk before check-in.
辦理入住前，客人可以暫時把行李寄放在櫃檯。

note: A common phrase meaning until things change; it works in speech and in writing.
常見片語，意思是在情況改變之前；口語與書面都能用。
Formal; for now, before a final decision is made.
較正式；在最終決定前暫時如此。
Tentatively means in a way that is not yet certain or final; temporarily is about a limited time.
tentatively 指尚未確定或最終；temporarily 則是時間上有限。

def: A person or business that pays rent to use a flat, office or land.
付租金以使用公寓、辦公室或土地的個人或企業。
ex: The new tenant will move into the apartment on the first of March.
新房客將在三月一日搬進這間公寓。
Each tenant is responsible for paying their own electricity bill.
每位承租人須自行負擔電費。
The landlord asked the tenants to report any leaks immediately.
房東要求房客一發現漏水就立刻通報。
A bank is the main tenant on the ground floor of the building.
一家銀行是這棟大樓一樓的主要承租戶。
Tenants must give thirty days' notice before ending the lease.
承租人必須在終止租約前三十天通知。

note: Mostly American English for a person or company that rents; tenant is more formal and legal.
主要是美式英語，指租用的人或公司；tenant 較正式、偏法律用語。
A legal term for the person who holds a lease.
法律用語，指持有租約的人。
A tenet is a principle or belief held by a group; it looks similar but has nothing to do with renting.
tenet 是團體所信奉的原則或信念；字形相近，但與租賃無關。

def: A building or station where journeys begin or end; also a computer workstation linked to a system.
旅程起訖的建築或車站；也指連接到系統的電腦終端機。
ex: The check-in desks are on the second floor of Terminal 2.
報到櫃檯在第二航廈的二樓。
The bus terminal is a ten-minute walk from the hotel.
公車總站離飯店步行約十分鐘。
Cargo ships unload at the container terminal on the east side of the harbour.
貨輪在港口東側的貨櫃碼頭卸貨。
Please insert your card into the payment terminal.
請把卡片插入刷卡機。
Staff can access the database from any terminal in the office.
員工可以在辦公室內任何一台終端機存取資料庫。

note: A station serves trains or buses along a route; a terminal is at the end of a line, or an airport or port building.
station 是路線沿途的火車或公車站；terminal 位於路線終點，或指機場、港口的建築。
Terminate is a verb meaning to end; terminal is mainly a noun for a station or computer.
terminate 是動詞，意為終止；terminal 主要是名詞，指站點或電腦終端機。

def: To end something, such as a contract or employment, officially.
正式結束某事，例如合約或僱用關係。
ex: The company may terminate the contract with thirty days' written notice.
公司可在三十天前書面通知後終止合約。
Her employment was terminated after the audit found serious errors.
稽核發現嚴重錯誤後，她被終止僱用。
This train will terminate at Central Station; all passengers must leave here.
這班列車的終點站為中央車站，所有乘客請在此下車。
The landlord terminated the lease when the tenant failed to pay rent.
房客未付租金，房東因此終止了租約。
We reserve the right to terminate your account if you break these rules.
如果你違反這些規定，我們保留終止你帳號的權利。

note: The everyday word; terminate is formal and typical of contracts and notices.
日常用語；terminate 較正式，常見於合約與通知。
To stop something planned or booked; terminate ends something already running.
指取消已計畫或預訂的事；terminate 是結束已在進行的事。
Exterminate means to kill pests or a whole group of living things; terminate means to end.
exterminate 指消滅害蟲或整群生物；terminate 指結束。

def: A thin, flat square piece of baked clay or stone used to cover floors and walls.
用來鋪地板與牆面的薄平方形陶土或石材片。
ex: The lobby floor is covered with white marble tiles.
大廳地板鋪著白色大理石磚。
Workers will tile the bathroom walls next week.
工人下週會替浴室牆面鋪磁磚。
Several roof tiles were blown off during the storm.
暴風雨中有幾片屋瓦被吹落。
Please order twenty extra tiles in case some break during installation.
請多訂二十片磁磚，以防安裝時有破損。
The kitchen was tiled in blue and white.
廚房貼的是藍白相間的磁磚。

note: A title is the name of a book, film or job position; it looks similar to tile but means something else.
title 是書、電影的名稱或職稱；字形與 tile 相近但意思不同。

def: A person who teaches skills to employees or athletes.
教導員工或運動員技能的人。
ex: The trainer showed new staff how to use the booking system.
訓練講師示範新進員工如何使用訂位系統。
We have invited an outside trainer to run the safety workshop.
我們邀請了一位外部講師來主持安全工作坊。
She works as a personal trainer at a fitness club downtown.
她在市中心的健身俱樂部擔任私人教練。
The company hired a language trainer for the sales team before the Seoul visit.
公司在首爾行程前為業務團隊聘請了語言講師。
The trainer gave each participant a handbook and a short quiz.
講師發給每位參加者一本手冊和一份簡短測驗。

note: Teaches a specific skill or course, often in a classroom or lesson.
教授特定技能或課程，常在教室或課堂上。
Guides a person or team to improve performance, often over a longer period.
引導個人或團隊提升表現，常為較長期。
A trainee is the person being trained; a trainer is the person who teaches.
trainee 是受訓的人；trainer 是教導的人。

def: To remove goods or cargo from a vehicle, ship or container.
把貨物從車輛、船隻或貨櫃上卸下來。
ex: Workers unloaded the pallets from the truck in less than an hour.
工人不到一小時就把棧板從卡車上卸下。
Please unload the boxes at the back entrance of the store.
請在商店後門卸下這些箱子。
The ship will unload its cargo at Kaohsiung Port on Thursday morning.
這艘船將於週四早上在高雄港卸貨。
Guests may unload their bags at the front door before parking.
客人可在停車前先在大門口卸下行李。
It took three people to unload the delivery van.
要三個人才卸得完這輛送貨廂型車。

note: A formal shipping term for unloading cargo from a ship.
航運用語，較正式，指從船上卸貨。

def: To improve something by replacing it with a better or newer version.
把東西換成更好或更新的版本以使其改善。
ex: We plan to upgrade all office computers before the new software arrives.
我們計畫在新軟體到貨前升級所有辦公室電腦。
Could I upgrade to a larger room for the extra night?
多住的那一晚我可以升級到較大的房間嗎？
The airline offered me a free upgrade to business class.
航空公司提供我免費升等到商務艙。
The network upgrade will take place this weekend; expect short interruptions.
網路升級將在本週末進行，預計會有短暫中斷。
The hotel recently upgraded its kitchen equipment.
這家飯店最近升級了廚房設備。

note: A general word for making something better in any way; upgrade means replacing or raising to a higher standard or class.
泛指以任何方式使其變好；upgrade 指換成或提升到較高標準或等級。
Update brings something up to date; an upgrade usually gives higher quality or more features.
update 是使其更新到最新；upgrade 通常帶來更高品質或更多功能。

def: On or to a higher floor of a building.
在建築物較高的樓層，或往較高的樓層。
ex: The conference room is upstairs, next to the manager's office.
會議室在樓上，就在經理辦公室旁邊。
Please take these documents upstairs to the accounting department.
請把這些文件拿到樓上的會計部。
The upstairs offices are being repainted this week.
樓上的辦公室這週正在重新粉刷。
The upstairs of the café is reserved for private events.
咖啡館的樓上保留給私人活動使用。
The printer is broken, so use the one upstairs.
這台印表機壞了，請用樓上那台。

def: A job that is available, or a room or space that is not occupied.
尚待補人的職位，或沒有人使用的房間或空間。
ex: We have a vacancy for a marketing assistant in our Taipei office.
我們台北辦公室有一個行銷助理的職缺。
The hotel has no vacancies this weekend because of the trade fair.
因為貿易展，這家飯店本週末沒有空房。
Applicants should apply for the vacancy by the end of the month.
應徵者請在月底前申請這個職缺。
A neon sign outside the motel read 'No Vacancy'.
汽車旅館外的霓虹招牌寫著『客滿』。
The chief accountant's retirement created a vacancy that must be filled quickly.
總會計師退休造成一個必須盡快補上的職缺。
The building has a low vacancy rate, so finding office space is hard.
這棟大樓的空置率很低，所以很難找到辦公空間。

note: Common, especially in American English, for an available job; vacancy is also used for rooms.
常用來指職缺，尤其是美式英語；vacancy 也可用於房間。
A vacation is time off work or school; a vacancy is an empty job or room.
vacation 是休假；vacancy 是空缺的職位或房間。

zh: 吸塵器；真空；用吸塵器清掃
def: A machine that cleans floors by sucking up dirt; also a space with no air.
吸起髒污來清潔地板的機器；也指沒有空氣的空間。
ex: The cleaner runs the vacuum through the offices every evening.
清潔人員每天傍晚用吸塵器清掃各辦公室。
Please vacuum the meeting room before the clients arrive.
客戶到達前，請先用吸塵器清理會議室。
Food stays fresh longer in vacuum-sealed packages.
食物放在真空密封包裝中可以保鮮較久。
The new robot vacuum works quietly under desks and chairs.
新的掃地機器人在桌椅底下安靜地運作。
The sudden departure of the CEO left a power vacuum in the company.
執行長突然離職，在公司裡留下權力真空。

def: A tall container, often of glass or china, used to hold cut flowers or as decoration.
常為玻璃或瓷製的高容器，用來插花或作裝飾。
ex: A vase of fresh roses stood on the reception desk.
接待櫃檯上擺著一瓶新鮮玫瑰。
The antique vase was packed carefully in foam before shipping.
這只古董花瓶在出貨前用泡棉仔細包好。
She placed the flowers in a glass vase and set it on the table.
她把花插進玻璃花瓶，放在桌上。
The vase arrived broken, so the customer asked for a refund.
花瓶送到時已經破了，所以顧客要求退款。
The gallery displays Ming-dynasty vases in a locked cabinet.
美術館把明代花瓶陳列在上鎖的展示櫃裡。

note: A jar is a wide container, usually for food or storage; a vase is for flowers or decoration.
jar 是寬口容器，通常裝食物或儲物；vase 是插花或裝飾用。

def: A person or company that sells goods or services, often to a business.
販售商品或服務的個人或公司，常是賣給企業。
ex: We are comparing quotes from three vendors before we choose a supplier.
我們在選定供應商之前，正在比較三家廠商的報價。
Street vendors sell snacks and drinks outside the stadium.
街頭小販在體育場外賣小吃和飲料。
The software vendor will provide training for all users.
軟體供應商將為所有使用者提供訓練。
Please pay the vendor within thirty days of receiving the invoice.
請在收到發票後三十天內付款給廠商。
Each vendor at the trade fair has a booth in Hall B.
貿易展上的每家廠商都在 B 館設有攤位。

note: A supplier provides goods or materials regularly to a company; vendor is broader and includes street sellers and software firms.
supplier 定期向公司供應貨品或材料；vendor 範圍較廣，包括小販與軟體公司。
A general word for anyone who sells; vendor is more common in business and trade settings.
泛指賣東西的人；vendor 在商業與貿易情境中較常用。
A venue is a place where an event happens; a vendor is a seller.
venue 是舉辦活動的場地；vendor 是賣方。

def: A place where an event, such as a meeting or concert, takes place.
舉辦活動（如會議或演唱會）的地點。
ex: We are still looking for a venue for the annual sales conference.
我們仍在為年度業務大會尋找場地。
The hotel ballroom is a popular venue for weddings and corporate dinners.
飯店宴會廳是婚禮與公司餐會的熱門場地。
The organisers changed the venue because too many people had registered.
報名人數太多，主辦單位因此更換了場地。
This concert venue can seat up to two thousand people.
這處演唱會場地最多可容納兩千人入座。
Please confirm the date and venue with the event team by Monday.
請在週一前與活動團隊確認日期與場地。

note: Location is any place; a venue is a place chosen for a particular event.
location 泛指任何地點；venue 是為特定活動選定的場地。
A vendor is a seller; a venue is a place for an event.
vendor 是賣方；venue 是活動場地。
An avenue is a wide street, often lined with trees or shops.
avenue 是寬闊的大道，常有行道樹或商店。

def: To choose not to enforce a rule, fee or right.
選擇不執行某項規定、費用或權利。
ex: The bank agreed to waive the late fee this time.
銀行同意這次免收逾期費。
The hotel will waive the cancellation charge if you rebook within a week.
如果你在一週內重新預訂，飯店將免收取消費。
By signing, you waive your right to take legal action.
簽署之後，你便放棄採取法律行動的權利。
The university waived the application fee for students from low-income families.
這所大學對低收入家庭的學生免收申請費。
The manager waived the dress code for the summer picnic.
經理在夏季野餐活動中免除了服裝規定。

note: Forgo means to do without something you could have; waive means to give up a right or not insist on a fee or rule.
forgo 指放棄本可擁有的東西；waive 指放棄權利，或不堅持收取費用、執行規定。
Wave means to move your hand or a flag; it sounds the same as waive.
wave 指揮手或揮動旗子；發音與 waive 相同。

def: A large building where goods are stored before they are sold or shipped.
貨物在銷售或出貨前存放的大型建築。
ex: The goods are stored in a warehouse near the airport.
這些貨物存放在機場附近的倉庫。
Our warehouse staff pack and ship about five hundred orders a day.
我們的倉庫人員每天包裝並出貨約五百張訂單。
The company plans to build a second warehouse to hold seasonal stock.
公司計畫興建第二座倉庫來存放季節性庫存。
Please send the delivery to the warehouse, not to the head office.
請把貨送到倉庫，不要送到總公司。
Items marked unavailable are currently out of stock at our main warehouse.
標示為無法購買的商品目前在我們的主倉庫缺貨。

note: A depot stores vehicles or goods for distribution and is often smaller and local.
depot 存放車輛或待配送貨物，通常規模較小且在地化。
A storeroom is a small room in a shop or office for supplies; a warehouse is a separate large building.
storeroom 是商店或辦公室內存放用品的小房間；warehouse 是獨立的大型建築。

def: A written promise by a maker to repair or replace a product if it fails within a set time.
製造商的書面承諾，在規定期間內產品故障時負責修理或更換。
ex: The laptop comes with a two-year warranty covering parts and labor.
這台筆電附有兩年保固，涵蓋零件與工資。
The repair is free because the printer is still under warranty.
因為印表機仍在保固期內，所以免費維修。
Opening the case will void the warranty.
拆開外殼會使保固失效。
Please keep your receipt as proof of purchase when you make a warranty claim.
申請保固時，請保留收據作為購買證明。
You can extend the warranty for an extra fee at the time of purchase.
購買時可以額外付費延長保固。

note: Often interchangeable for products; guarantee can also mean any firm promise.
用於產品時常可互換；guarantee 也可指任何堅定的承諾。
A warrant is an official document giving someone legal authority, such as to search a place; as a verb it means to justify.
warrant 是賦予某人法律權限的正式文件，例如搜索令；作動詞時意為證明有正當理由。

def: Any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday.
一週中除了週六和週日以外的任何一天。
ex: The office is open on every weekday from nine to six.
辦公室每個平日從九點開到六點。
Orders placed after noon are processed on the next weekday.
中午過後下的訂單，會在下一個平日處理。
On weekdays, the express train to the airport runs every ten minutes.
平日時，前往機場的快車每十分鐘一班。
Parking is free on weekday evenings but costs five dollars on weekends.
平日晚上停車免費，週末則收五元。
Tickets are cheaper on a weekday than at the weekend.
平日的票價比週末便宜。

note: A day when banks and offices are open; it excludes public holidays, which weekday does not.
銀行與公司營業的日子，不含國定假日；weekday 則不排除國定假日。
A day on which people work; weekday is defined by the calendar, Monday to Friday.
指人們工作的日子；weekday 是以日曆定義，即週一至週五。
Weekly means once a week or every week; weekday means one day from Monday to Friday.
weekly 指每週一次；weekday 指週一到週五的某一天。

def: Any person who; no matter who.
任何…的人；不管是誰。
ex: Whoever arrives first should unlock the meeting room.
最先到的人要負責開會議室的門。
Please give the parcel to whoever is at the front desk.
請把包裹交給櫃檯當班的任何人。
Whoever calls while I am in the meeting, please take a message.
我開會時不管誰來電，請幫我留言。
Our policy is to hire whoever is best qualified for the job.
我們的政策是錄用最符合職務資格的人。
The contract will be signed by whoever replaces Mr. Wu.
合約將由接替吳先生的人簽署。

note: Means the same in many sentences; whoever also suggests it does not matter which person.
在許多句子裡意思相同；whoever 另含不管是哪一位都一樣的意味。
Whomever is the object form, used in formal writing; whoever is the subject of its own clause.
whomever 是受格，用於正式寫作；whoever 是其子句的主詞。

def: A short training session where people practice skills, or a room where things are made or repaired.
讓人練習技能的短期訓練課程，或製作、修理東西的工作間。
ex: All new managers must attend a leadership workshop in May.
所有新任經理都必須在五月參加領導力工作坊。
The workshop will cover time management and effective email writing.
這場工作坊將涵蓋時間管理與有效的電子郵件寫作。
Our repair workshop is at the back of the building.
我們的維修工作室在大樓後方。
She leads a two-hour workshop on presentation skills each month.
她每個月主持一場兩小時的簡報技巧工作坊。
Participants will practice interviewing techniques in small groups during the workshop.
工作坊期間，參加者將分小組練習面試技巧。

note: Usually led by an expert who talks and discusses; a workshop involves hands-on practice.
通常由專家講述並討論；workshop 則有動手練習。
The place where people work; a workshop is a training event or a small room for making things.
workplace 是人們工作的地方；workshop 是培訓活動或製作東西的小工作間。
